description:
Ruined King Redux

A refined take on default Viego using VFX ported from his Exalted skin.
**Ruined King Redux** enhances the base version of Viego with carefully adapted and recolored effects taken from the Exalted variant, redesigned to perfectly fit the original Ruined King aesthetic.

The goal wasn’t to turn Viego into a walking flashbang — it was to make default Viego feel like the definitive version of the champion. Cleaner visuals, heavier mist, sharper spectral energy, and more polished ability effects while fully preserving the base skin identity.

### Features

* VFX ported from Exalted Viego
* Fully recolored to match default Viego’s palette
* Enhanced mist and spectral effects
* Improved visual impact and clarity
* Keeps original animations and thematic identity
* Lore-friendly visual overhaul for base Viego

A mod made for people who already liked default Viego, but wanted it to feel less “old Riot particle system held together with duct tape” and more like a modern Ruined King experience.
